ROLE: Decide whether a byte slice is a legal MQTT Topic Filter: at least one character, at most 65535 bytes, well-formed UTF-8 without U+0000, '#' only alone or after a separator and always last, '+' only as a complete level.

FUNC.NAME: topic_utf8_validate
FUNC.ROLE: Well-formedness and U+0000 check on the same slice

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: topic_utf8_validate
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 1 when the slice is well-formed UTF-8 with no U+0000; 0 otherwise
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: no ownership; the slice is only read
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: a 0 result rejects the whole filter (MQTT-1.5.3-1/-2)

LOGIC.INPUT: filter points to len caller-owned bytes of a decoded SUBSCRIBE Topic Filter field; filter may be NULL only when len is 0.
LOGIC.ACTION: 1) Reject len == 0 (filters are at least one character, MQTT-4.7.3-1) and len > 65535 (MQTT-4.7.3-3) and filter == NULL. 2) Reject any encoding of U+0000 and any ill-formed UTF-8 by requiring topic_utf8_validate(filter, len) == 1. 3) Scan bytes with index i: for byte 0x23 ('#') require (i == 0 || filter[i-1] == '/') and i == len - 1, otherwise reject: the multi-level wildcard must stand alone or follow a separator and MUST be the last character of the filter (MQTT-4.7.1-2). For byte 0x2B ('+') require (i == 0 || filter[i-1] == '/') and (i == len - 1 || filter[i+1] == '/'), otherwise reject: the single-level wildcard must occupy an entire level (MQTT-4.7.1-3). Other bytes, including space, '$' and empty levels, are unrestricted. 4) Return 1.
LOGIC.OUTPUT: 1 for a legal Topic Filter, 0 otherwise; the slice is unmodified.
INVARIANTS_USED: wildcard placement is level based and byte wise
LOGIC.PRECONDITION: filter is NULL with len == 0 or points to len readable bytes.
LOGIC.POSTCONDITION: the slice is unmodified and the result depends only on its bytes and length
